math_review.pair_depth: Minimum of four exact center/radius SAT depths, with each owner support radius using the opposite square size.
math_review.energy: One unordered-pair squared penetration plus each four-wall squared penetration; intentional new proposal objective, not the old weighted/clearance loss.
math_review.gradient: Directed center/angle signs and opposite-size coefficients agree with dense corrected formulation. Mixed exact ties choose the one-sided ghost-angle-active branches then average both approaches; unit-size ties use symmetric active axes. Prior naive generalized-gradient failure remains preserved.
math_review.broad_phase: All side lengths <=1 implies overlap center distance <=sqrt(2), within original 1.5 cells/3x3 neighborhood and radial cutoff2.00000001, including clipped boundary cells.
math_review.unit_count: All old N-1 squares retain side1; only rowN-1 has prescribed positive lambda. Angles/centers all free; no unit scaling.
math_review.history: Fresh allocation and evaluation for every fixed-size stage; no cross-size Metropolis comparisons.
math_review.scope: Independent source/algebra and bounded existing-control review, not a general global convergence claim or a substitute for actual CUDA controls.

protocol_review.stage_retention: Each returned pose/lambda/side packet and hash metadata commits before the next quench.
protocol_review.collection: Both registered arm process groups, including native descendants, are stopped/waited before output hashing and ZIP creation; supervisor repeats group cleanup.
protocol_review.admission: Only explicit final stage11 with all lambda==1 can reach the unchanged native full-gate helper. Mixed stages remain UNVERIFIED.
protocol_review.finisher: At most4 fixed strata/case,2workers,60native+8gates; latest canonical comparison remains required at final merge.
protocol_review.bounds: Paired actual preflight barrier;300s search;570s worker;575s supervisor wait;595s alarm;600s stated whole,720s server.
